name: Organization
description: A company or institution — employer, vendor, target company, etc.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: Other names it goes by — short forms, transliterations, former names.

attributes.name: employees
attributes.description: People with a current Membership in it.

attributes.name: descriptions
attributes.description: How this one has been described, in whoever's words — several are normal, because people describe the same thing differently and each telling is worth keeping.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The latest of this one's descriptions, as one string. Writing it adds a description; they all live there.

methods.name: research
methods.description: Ground/enrich attributes and notes via live search (Tavily) — facts, news, funding.

methods.name: add_contact
methods.description: Link a Person to this organization (sets person.organization and appends to employees).

relations.members: people who work, study or belong there
relations.part_of: the organization it is a department or branch of; parts — its departments
